title: Southeast Museum of Photography

services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: With a 40 year history, the Southeast Museum of Photography has hosted and curated hundreds of exhibitions. The following list provides a brief overview of highlights from our exhibition history. Photographers and curators James and LaToya Carey capture the essence of Central Florida through the lives and stories of its people. Their work vividly portrays the Black experience, skillfully using the interplay of light and shadow to reveal its beauty. Each thoughtfully crafted narrative enriches the exhibit, celebrating every individual as a masterpiece in their own right.
